start_here: Say to your AI: "Is my engine builder at releases.example.com receiving pushes, and which release did it publish last?" It runs status with the same request.json install used and reads back the receiver, the feed and the last run.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it reads the builder's receiver, feed folder and last-run file over SSH and answers one status.
instructions: 1. Use the request.json install was given (builder address and host_name, ssh known_hosts, repository). No credential is needed; it reaches the builder over SSH only.

2. The AI reads the row with tools:list {tool: "tool:read-an-engine-builder"} and runs, from the Workshop checkout: node tools/publish-an-engine-release/do-work/install-a-builder.mjs status request.json

3. Read the JSON line: receiver_active, public_key, releases_held (entries in feed.json, at most 32), newest (the newest commit, sequence, target and urgent flag for each target), last_run and feed_status (the HTTP status of the feed at its public address).

4. A last_run whose error says a commit is older than the feed's newest is expected and harmless; any other error in last_run says what to fix, and a receiver_active false means the service must be restarted.

worked_examples.title: A builder that has published one commit
worked_examples.ask: Is my engine builder receiving pushes, and which release did it publish last?
worked_examples.given: Read from tools/publish-an-engine-release/do-work/install-a-builder.mjs (builderStatus) and do-work/receive-pushes.mjs (runPublish) for the builder installed from {"builder":{"address":"192.0.2.50","host_name":"releases.example.com"},"ssh":{"known_hosts":"/work/known_hosts"},"repository":{"url":"https://github.com/owner/engine.git","branch":"main"}} after one push of a commit made at second 1800000003: the AI runs node tools/publish-an-engine-release/do-work/install-a-builder.mjs status request.json. The builder answers systemctl is-active with active, its feed.json holds the entry for that commit, last-run.json holds the run, and the feed answers HTTP 200.
worked_examples.hands_back: {"receiver_active":true,"public_key":"<64 hex of the builder's key>","releases_held":1,"newest":[{"commit":"<the 40-hex commit>","sequence":1800000003,"target":"x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu","urgent":false}],"last_run":{"commit":"<the 40-hex commit>","started_at":"<time>","finished_at":"<time>","exit":0,"release":{"commit":"<the 40-hex commit>","sequence":1800000003,"target":"x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu","already_published":false}},"last_entries":[],"feed_status":200} (last_run.release is the full answer publish printed).
